column1: # zvf_iter94_stability.tsv — cross-library ZVF stability score. alarm_rate_proxy = 1 - n_never_alarmed/n_traces (iter90). recovery_rate = recovered/total_episodes at K=5. post_recovery_delta = mean(post-recovery ha) - mean(post-sustained ha). stability_score = (1-alarm_rate)*60 + recovery_rate*30 + max(0, 1-|delta_h|)*10.
